rows.name: Yarmouth
rows.description: Green outer lt. near castle wall; inner br. lt. In one S.S.W. lead into the harb. Temporary lt. on end of wooden pier constructing

rows.name: Needles Outer Rock
rows.character: One fixed bright, or red light
rows.description: Shows red to S. from S.E. ½ S. to W.; then bright over entrance of Needles Channel to W.N.W.; thence red up the ch[?]nnel to N.E. by E., and then bright to N.E. by E. ½ E., to clear Warden Ledge. A bell in fogs

rows.name: Hurst Beach
rows.character: Two bright fixed lights (Low lt. in New Fort)
rows.description: In one N.E. by E. ½ E., 670 feet apart. Another light in the lighthouse shows only up the Solent

rows.name: Poole
rows.description: In one, N. ½ W., 786 feet apart on North side of entrance; also four lights inside

rows.name: Weymouth
rows.description: Two red lts. near beach, E. of railway station Two green lights on North pier

rows.name: PORTLAND
rows.character: High lt., br. and fixed Low lt., br. and fixed
rows.description: White towers, 50 & 85 ft. high, 1,509 ft. apart, near the Bill. In one, N.W. by N., lead betw. Race and Shambles. Low lt. only shown between N.W. by N. ¾ N. and E.S.E.

rows.name: Portland Breakwater
rows.description: Shown from centre of fort at end of Breakwater. Lt. obscured by peninsula between S.S.W. & W. by S. ½ S., & betw. W. by S. ½ S. & W.N.W. lt. is obscured to an observer 15 feet above the sea when within 2 miles of Chesil Bank. Fog Bell

rows.name: Shambles Shoal Lt.-Ves.
rows.description: On E. end of shoal, in 15 fms. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 2 min. Warning Gun

rows.name: Lyme Regis
rows.description: In one, N.W. ½ N., 825 ft. apart. A bright leading light in centre of channel, N. ¼ W.

rows.name: Teignmouth
rows.description: One on a limestone tower on S.W. end of Denn; the other on a house

rows.name: Brixham
rows.description: Red lt. at end of breakwater. Green lt. at end of W. pier. Entering by night, keep N. of Shoalstone Point to open red lt. on inner pier, which leads clear of breakwater

rows.name: Torquay
rows.character: One red, one br. fix. lt.
rows.description: Bright light on inner pier, showing red to westward; red light on outer pier

rows.name: Dartmouth
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright red or green light 2. One bright fix. lt. 3. One small bright, red, or green light
rows.description: 1. On Kingswear or N. side; br. lt. towards fairway, between S. ¾ E. and S. by E. ½ E.; thence red lt. to the land, and green lt. to S.W., between S. ½ W. and the land, or over Checkstone, Pin Rock, &c. 2. S. ¾ E. 110 ft. from former; in one leads up fairway 3. Near Coast-guard Station; br. in fairway, red over shoals on N. side of harbour, and green lt. over shoal of One Gun Point to S.

rows.name: START POINT
rows.character: One brilliant revol. lt., visible every minute
rows.description: A white tower, 92 ft. high. A fix. lt. at 181 ft. is also vis. from tower over Skerries Rocks betw. N.E. ¾ E. and E. ½ N. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes

rows.name: Plymouth Breakwater
rows.character: One bright or red light Lower bright light
rows.description: On W. end; red to seaward, but br. E. of N.E. ½ E. from lt. A lower br. lt. is seen when the channel is open. A bell during fogs

rows.name: Plymouth Harbour
rows.description: On W. Barbican pier-head is shown a br. lt., a red lt. on Millbay pier-head, & also one at Mt. Wise landing. Fog-bell, 8 strokes a min.

rows.name: EDDYSTONE
rows.description: An admirable stone tower, with red and white bands, 89 ft. above foundation on the rock, which covers 14 ft. at high water. Fog-bell, 5 strokes once in every ½ minute

rows.name: Falmouth
rows.character: One rev. lt. 20 secs. Lower fixed light One green fixed light
rows.description: On St. Anthony Pt. The lower lt. to S.S.W. over Manacles Rocks, between S.S.W. ½ W. and S. by W. ¼ W. Fog-bell struck 4 times in every alternate ½ minute On Prince of Wales breakwater
